# Introduction

Most statistical models can be seen as a special case or extension of the General Linear Model: 
$$
\bm{Y}=\bm{X}\bm{\beta}+\bm{\epsilon}.
$$ {#eq-GLM}

For @eq-GLM, A-optimality of a design is based on $\op{tr}((\bm{X}^\top\bm{X})^{-1})$.

@pearsonInheritanceInsanity1905 is an old reference, but there are older ones [@spearmanProofMeasurementAssociation1904].
